messages:
maya: FYI customer reporting a huge invoice jump for March vs Feb, claims SDK estimates were ~12k tokens/day but invoice shows ~120k. Customer org: acme-payments. I'm attaching their quick repro below.

maya: customer says they call our Python SDK with streaming and function-calls enabled; SDK prints estimator ~11k but they see 10x charges on invoice.

devon: can you paste the minimal repro curl/python they used? also any metering trace ids? :eyes:

maya: here's the snippet they sent (sanitized):

maya: ```bash
# curl repro (customer):
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-2-70b","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize attached invoice and highlight anomalies."}],"stream":true,"function_call":{"name":"pdf_extract"}}'
```

maya: and their python SDK call: 

maya: ```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=TOKEN)
resp = c.generate_stream(model='rwd-llama-2-70b', messages=msgs, function_call={'name':'pdf_extract'})
# client prints estimator based on local tokenizer before streaming
print('estimator tokens', c.estimate_tokens(msgs))
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```

ashwin: thanks. do we have any metering logs tied to their org for the date range? billingbot: I pulled metering summary earlier, trace id mt-9f3a-20260321 attached to their largest spike.

metering-bot: metering log (mt-9f3a-20260321): total_tokens=118,432 prompt_tokens=12,045 completion_tokens=106,387 metadata={"injected_tool_payload_tokens":94000,"tool_name":"pdf_extractor","org_id":"acme-payments"}

devon: whoa — injected_tool_payload_tokens ~94k. That seems to be the difference. sounds like the tool (pdf_extractor) returned a full base64 dump of the PDF and we counted it as completion tokens on server side. SDK estimator didn't see that because it only estimates before tool output is generated.

maya: customer says their PDF was ~2MB and they expected the tool to return only a short summary, but a downstream library returned full text+ocr dump.

ashwin: reproduction plan: 1) run the same request with stream=false and capture response body; 2) run with stream=true and capture chunk stream; 3) fetch server metering event for request_id in trace id; 4) compare token counts with our tokenizer.

devon: quick commands to capture streamed payload and count tokens on client: 

devon: ```bash
# capture streamed response (raw)
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate > streamed.raw
# later extract tool payload from streamed.raw and run our tokenizer locally (node/python) to count tokens
python -c "from redwood.tokenize import count; import sys, json; data=json.load(open('tool_payload.json')); print(count(data['text']))"
```

maya: customer attached a short excerpt from their streamed.raw showing a final tool payload chunk: 

maya: ```json
{"id":"chunk-xyz","type":"tool_output","tool":"pdf_extractor","content":"<base64-omitted>... (30KB)"}
```

devon: key point: server metering counts anything we write into the completion stream (including tool outputs we synthesize or relayed). SDK estimator that runs client-side before response cannot predict that.

ashwin: mitigation options: 
- short term: refund/credit for March for acme-payments while customer adjusts tool config
- medium: update docs/FAQ to call out that server-injected tool outputs are billed as completions and will not appear in pre-request SDK estimates
- long term: SDK could optionally subscribe to a "post-render estimate" telemetry event from the server (requires opt-in and privacy review)

support_lead: agreed on credits. maya, please run refund flow and assign ticket priority P1. Also add a KB doc.

maya: on it — filing refund now and pinging customer to gate tool output size. will attach our recommended config changes (truncate tool outputs, prefer pointers/uris).

devon: also opening an infra issue to add a clearer metering field: currently we have metadata.injected_tool_payload_tokens but we should surface a breakdown per-request in the console UI. filing INF-2467.

metering-bot: INF-2467 created by devon, link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-2467

ashwin: note for engineers: when debugging future token deltas, check these three things in order: 1) any server-side tool injection (tool output/KV cache dumps), 2) reranks or replays that trigger additional completions, 3) streaming re-tries where completion fragments are duplicated in logs.

maya: customer confirm received refund note and will change extractor config. They also asked if we can add a webhooks flag to notify before tool outputs exceed X tokens.

devon: feature request makes sense. we can prototype a server-side pre-bill hook that POSTs potential_token_estimate to a configured webhook if estimated_completion_tokens > threshold. file FR-482.

support_lead: please add follow-ups to the ticket with ETA for KB and UI field change. thanks team :heart:
